labeling_rule: This artifact is a frozen derivation contract. It contains no derived gold, no results and no campaign outcomes, and must never be cited as evidence that any lifecycle-contract campaign passed. Gold derived under this contract exists only after the campaign executes and its receipts land.
issue_binding: SzeChunYiu/ORION#1086 P13+P14: 'Derive gold only from objective facts: object/hash existence, ancestry, tag/signature, test exit and timestamp order.'

gold_rule_binding.relation: The V1 rule of record is binding on this contract by hash. The five admissible fact classes below operationalise its five numbered items; nothing here relaxes, widens or reinterprets the rule.

derivation_preconditions.corpus_membership: The subject repository must be an entry of P13_P14_PINNED_REPOSITORY_CORPUS_V1.json at the pinned_sha recorded there; derivation against any other revision of the same repository is inadmissible.
derivation_preconditions.license_gate: The entry's license.verification must be VERIFIED_WITH_URL_AND_DATE. An entry whose license.verification is CANNOT_CHECK__LICENSE_UNCLEAR is pinned for record only and yields no gold; every predicate on it returns CANNOT_CHECK.
derivation_preconditions.clone_verification: Gold may be derived only inside a clone whose HEAD equals the pinned_sha (git rev-parse HEAD equality asserted before and after derivation).
derivation_preconditions.fail_closed: Any predicate error, ambiguity, timeout or partial evidence yields the label CANNOT_CHECK for that fact. No label is ever inferred from absence of evidence, from model or author opinion, or by interpolating between recorded facts.

admissible_fact_classes.fact: Object O (commit, blob, tree or tag) exists in the pinned repository state, and its content digest equals the claimed digest.

predicate.machine_check: exit 0 and the printed object id equals the claimed id, with <clone> HEAD == corpus pinned_sha

admissible_fact_classes.inadmissible_interpretations: Any claim about what the object's content means, represents or implies; existence is a label about graph membership only.

admissible_fact_classes.fact: Commit A is an ancestor of commit B (or equal to it) in the pinned history.

predicate.machine_check: exit 0 -> TRUE; exit 1 -> FALSE; any other exit -> CANNOT_CHECK

admissible_fact_classes.inadmissible_interpretations: Causal responsibility, authorship intent, or 'who introduced what' attribution beyond the bare ancestry relation.

admissible_fact_classes.fact: Ref T resolves to the claimed target object, and a tag carries a cryptographic signature that verifies.

predicate.machine_check: target equality asserted by rev-parse; verify-tag exit 0 -> SIGNATURE_VALID; exit 1 with an unsigned tag -> UNSIGNED; exit 1 with a malformed or failing signature -> SIGNATURE_INVALID
predicate.label_type: TARGET_MATCH | TARGET_MISMATCH | SIGNATURE_VALID | UNSIGNED | SIGNATURE_INVALID | CANNOT_CHECK

admissible_fact_classes.inadmissible_interpretations: Trust, identity or organisational-authority judgments; a valid signature is a label about cryptography, never about endorsement. UNSIGNED is a recorded state, not a defect.

admissible_fact_classes.fact: The recorded test command, executed on the pinned revision in the locked runtime recorded for the campaign, exited with the recorded status.

predicate.machine_check: the exit status integer recorded verbatim at execution time inside the locked runtime, with the invocation and its output digest receipted; a status that cannot be re-observed in the receipt is CANNOT_CHECK

admissible_fact_classes.inadmissible_interpretations: Quality, correctness, maintainability or 'project health' inferences from an exit status; the label is the status only.

admissible_fact_classes.fact: The committer (or author) timestamp recorded for commit A is strictly less than, equal to, or greater than that of commit B.

predicate.machine_check: integer comparison of the two recorded epoch values

admissible_fact_classes.inadmissible_interpretations: Wall-clock or real-world event-ordering claims; committed timestamps reflect committer clocks and can be skewed, so the label orders recorded values only.

prohibitions: Gold labels of any other kind — semantic quality, responsibility, social appropriateness, governance correctness, model- or author-authored opinions — are inadmissible and remain CANNOT_CHECK at the campaign layer unless adjudicated under the blinded external protocol with two independent experts plus tie-break/custodian.
ORION itself is never an external subject of its own lifecycle-contract campaign; no SzeChunYiu-owned repository may appear as a subject.
Public online data does not create independent adjudication; a local hash proves chronology but not independence.
Missing license, gold, comparator, custody or semantic authority remains CANNOT_CHECK; no weak substitute may be silently substituted.

box_objective_gold_derivation.detail: The five objective fact classes are frozen as machine-checkable predicates with fail-closed CANNOT_CHECK semantics and hash-bound to the V1 rule of record. No gold has been derived; no campaign has executed.
box_objective_gold_derivation.open_remainder: derive gold per these predicates on the license-eligible corpus subset; execute the lifecycle/RCS-vs-baselines campaign; comparators and custodial boundaries stay CANNOT_CHECK until they exist.
